info.title: Xona Media Generation
info.description:
AI media generation gated by x402 micropayments (USDC on Solana). Image generation and editing, short video generation, music generation, text-to-speech, and speech transcription. Results are returned as CDN URLs.

x402 flow: call any endpoint without payment to receive an HTTP 402 challenge, pay in USDC on Solana mainnet, then retry the request with the payment-signature header.
